Dear Participants:

You are invited to participate in a research study conducted by faculty and graduate student researchers from the Department of Agribusiness and Food Industry Management at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona. The purpose of this study is to understand how adults engage with yoga and wellness content online, including attitudes toward yoga, use of digital platforms such as YouTube, and interest in online wellness offerings.

This study involves research on how adults engage with yoga and wellness content online, including the use of digital platforms such as YouTube. You will be asked to complete a brief anonymous online survey that includes questions about yoga involvement, wellness behaviors, online video usage, and interest in digital yoga content. The survey consists of multiple-choice and rating-scale questions only. You may work at your own pace. Our experience indicates that completing the survey takes approximately 5–10 minutes. The questions are non-intrusive, and we do not anticipate that you will experience discomfort or negative feelings while participating.

Your participation in this study is completely voluntary. There is no compensation for participation.

 Although there are no direct benefits to you, your participation may help improve understanding of how individuals interact with online yoga and wellness content. This research is anonymous, and none of your responses can be directly traced back to you.
